# Open Vault Capital Group

> Open Vault Capital Group, LLC provides fast, flexible capital solutions for
> real estate investors. Tagline: "Your Deal, Our Capital — Unlocking Capital
> for Every Opportunity."

Open Vault Capital Group connects real estate investors with a network of
funding sources and works to match the right capital to each deal. Investors
submit a deal and receive a prompt review.

## Contact

- Email: funding@openvaultcapital.com
- Phone: +1 (801) 317-8007
- Website: https://openvaultcapital.com/
- Deal submission: via the "Submit Your Deal" button on https://openvaultcapital.com/

## Loan Programs

- Transactional Funding
- Double Closings
- Fix & Flip
- Buy & Hold
- BRRRR
- Wholesale
- Multifamily
- Commercial
- New Construction
- EMD Funding
- Bridge Loans
- Rental Portfolio
- Cash-Out Refinance
- Gap Funding
- Private Capital
- Creative Financing

## Why Investors Choose Us

- **Capital Connections** — Access to a network of funding solutions tailored
  to your deal.
- **Investor Focused** — We understand investment opportunities and work to
  match the right capital.
- **Responsive** — We review submissions promptly so you can keep your deal
  moving.
